# anthropic_effective_spend_limits (Data Source)

Lists each member's effective spend limit and period-to-date spend, one row per (member, period), with the scope the limit was inherited from (`GET /v1/organizations/spend_limits/effective`). Claude Enterprise organizations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_effective_spend_limits" "member" {
  user_ids = ["user_01EXAMPLE"]
  periods  = ["monthly"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `periods` (List of String) Only report these periods: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`. Omit for every period a member resolves a limit for.
- `user_ids` (List of String) Only report these members (`user_...` IDs, at most 100). Omit for all members.

### Read-Only

- `effective_limits` (Attributes List) Effective limit rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--effective_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_limits`

Read-Only:

- `actor_id` (String) User ID, or scoped API key ID for a scoped key actor.
- `actor_type` (String) `user_actor` or `scoped_api_key_actor`.
- `amount` (String) Effective limit in minor currency units (cents for USD). Null when no limit applies for this period.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 billing currency code.
- `period` (String) Period this row reports.
- `period_to_date_spend` (String) Spend so far this period in minor currency units. It may carry up to three decimal places.
- `source_id` (String) Identifier of the source scope (user ID, seat tier, RBAC group ID, service, or workspace ID). Null for the organization scope.
- `source_type` (String) Scope type the limit was inherited from (`user`, `seat_tier`, `rbac_group`, `organization_service`, `organization`, ...).
- `spend_limit_id` (String) ID of the spend limit that applies, if any.
